text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
TWEENDECKERS - Bangor - (built 1984) 4,800 dwt sold to French buyers for $4.5 million with timecharter.
REEFERS - White Mountain - (built 1983) 8,160 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $7.2 million.
RORO - Hamlet Saudia - (built 1978) 12,424 dwt sold to Dutch buyers for $3.1 million.
Inzhener Machulskiy - (built 1974) 6,128 dwt sold to Russian buyers for $1.57 million.
Stakhanovets Kotov - (built 1978) sold to U.S. based buyers for $1.5 million.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Pivot - (built 1975) 232,115 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $192 per ldt.
Onezhskiy - (built 1970) 11,816 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $181 per ldt.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
